overview: "Abeja Voladora" follows Ramona, a woman who begins working as a reporter at a major newspaper. After being sexually assaulted by her boss, she sets out to seek revenge, committing crimes that start drawing the attention of detective Benjamin Flores. As Benjamin investigates the cases, he unexpectedly begins to fall in love with Ramona, unaware that she is the one behind the violent acts.
tagline: This is not a love story.
title: Abeja Voladora
